**Date:** The announcement was made on 14 March at the Calder Vane Foundation's annual ceremony.

**Person:** Tobias Wrenfield, chair of the Calder Vane jury, presented the award and read the citation.

**Figure:** The prize carries an award of 85,000 vane-marks, chosen from 212 submitted projects.

**Source:** The report rests on the jury's published citation, "Statement of the Calder Vane Architecture Jury," which praised Ashgrove's Lowmere Harbour Pavilion.
